name: sudokumaker-custom-constraints
description: Worked examples of custom SudokuMaker constraint components.

standard.//: The .js files are constraint snippets pasted into SudokuMaker. `globals` names the API globals SudokuMaker injects (helpers, SudokuDigitSet), the component constructors main.js references, and the names a `// #include` splices into a paste target (frameLines, framePairs -- declared in _shared/frame-lines.js, called from each main-global.js; windowLength -- declared in examples/outside-sudoku/window-length.js, called from both outside-sudoku mains; lineKind and its BARE/HOUSE/FULL_HOUSE kinds -- declared in _shared/line-kind.js, called from the outside-clue components; neighbours, domFold, subtreeSums and starveVerdict -- declared in _shared/dominator.js, called from the isofill and fillomino components; below -- declared in _shared/below.js, called from both running-start components); each component file disables no-unused-vars for its API functions. `ignore` holds verbatim third-party files under examples/, which must stay exactly as their author wrote them, and all of docs/research/: vendored baselines (the fillomino one, plus FillominoComponentNoLog.js -- #307's log-free timing variant, kept in the vendor's own style so the comparison stays apples-to-apples) and throwaway probe scripts frozen as the record of a closed investigation (see CODING_STANDARDS.md). Research is not maintained source, so the gate never reads it (#413).
